messages:
alex.k: FYI: EU upstream incident just escalated — telecom provider in eu-west-1 causing intermittent 5xx across routed tenants. Recommend we hold the 3.2.0 rollout scheduled in ~20m. @deploybot please pause any queued releases for EU.
deploybot: deploybot: pausing rollout 3.2.0 across eu regions as requested. paused_by=alex.k reason=incident-eu-telecom action_required=ops_approval
maria.ops: Confirming hold. Proposing to shift our change window from 18:00-22:00 to 22:30-01:30 as a placeholder. @sre_oncall can you validate current SLO impact before we reschedule?
sre_oncall: Running checks. Current eu-west-1 5xx spike ~6% over last 5m, latency + tail increase. Canary (us-west) unaffected. Recommend holding until errors <0.5% sustained for 15m.
chris.product: We should freeze release notes and external comms until we have an ETA. I'll draft a short note: "Release deferred due to upstream network incident in EU; new ETA TBC" and share with partners.
liz.ops: If we defer, do we want to immediately toggle the EU feature-flag off to avoid any partial exposure? I can flip the flag and log the change.
alex.k: Yes please unpin the feature-flag for eu traffic (ff:web-3.2 rollout -> OFF). Also create a ticket for a postmortem that includes release gating logic and decision timeline.
maria.ops: Proposed plan (short): 1) Hold release (deploybot paused) 2) FF off for EU 3) Observe 30m for 5xx decline 4) If stable, reschedule to 03:00 UTC with limited canary; else push to next change window. Ack?
chris.product: :thumbsup: ack from product.
sre_oncall: Monitoring running. Sharing dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/eu-telemetry (watching 5m/15m windows). Will update in 10m.
deploybot: deploybot: releases for 3.2.0 remain in paused state. To resume manually: `/deploy resume 3.2.0 --by alex.k`. Auto-resume disabled while paused_by present.
alex.k: Reschedule proposal: target 03:00 UTC, run a limited canary 03:00-03:30 at 10% traffic, then ramp to 50% then 100% if no regressions. Abort and rollback criteria: >0.5% 5xx or sustained latency >300ms p99 for 10m.
maria.ops: Noted and added to release_notes: "deferred due to third-party network incident; rescheduled to 03:00 UTC pending stability checks". I'll also set a calendar hold until confirmed.
sre_oncall: Update at +12m: eu 5xx now 0.8% over 5m and trending down. Continuing 15m watch before greenlight.
liz.ops: I'll coordinate on-call coverage for the 03:00 window and tag #incidents and #eng-oncall for visibility.
chris.product: Also re-opening docs PR to add an explicit rollback runbook for this release: https://github.com/redwoodinc/release-notes/pull/432 — pls review if you have a minute.
alex.k: Thanks all. If anyone sees deploybot auto-resume or unexpected state changes, ping here immediately. I'll update the release calendar and close this thread once the window is confirmed or we move to the next slot.
(incident-bot): incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-042 detected: upstream provider eu-west-1 network instability. Severity: S2. Acknowledged by ops.
